Algorithms available in this installation

Source: R/algorithms.R
zujwt_info.Rd

zujwt_info() lists every JOSE algorithm zujwt knows and whether it can be used here. An algorithm is available when this version of zujwt implements it and the installed zucrypt provides what it needs: zucrypt is the version in the zucrypt column or later, or already exports the functions that version adds. Using one that is not raises zujwt_unsupported_error.

Usage

zujwt_info()

Value

A data frame with columns algorithm, kind ("signature", "key management" or "content encryption"), available, and zucrypt, the zucrypt version the algorithm needs.

Examples

info <- zujwt_info()
info[info$available, ]

#> 2               HS384          signature      TRUE   0.1.0
